tokens.reason: BOLD is the new stablecoin used for rewards distribution to initiatives

tokens.name: bribeToken
tokens.reason: BribeInitiative uses a secondary bribe token alongside BOLD for incentives

time_sensitive.reason: Governance is highly epoch-based with EPOCH_DURATION, EPOCH_START, and time-weighted voting power calculations

multi_user.reason: depositLQTYViaPermit requires valid EIP-2612 permit signatures, needs actor with known private key

proxy_deployment.reason: Users must interact with stakingV1 through a UserProxy contract deployed via Governance

struct_params.reason: PermitParams used in depositLQTYViaPermit functions; single valid permit sufficient for testing
ClaimData struct used in claimBribes; single claim configuration sufficient

Allocation struct passed to onAfterAllocateLQTY hook; single allocation pattern sufficient
InitiativeState passed to onAfterAllocateLQTY hook; single state pattern sufficient
